headline: The app can see your sound again — meters, now-playing, and the upmix are all live
note: Your biggest complaints came from one thing: in plugin mode the app was no longer in the audio path, so it couldn't meter or detect anything. The plugin now reports its live per-speaker levels back to the app. Result: the status shows your actual song (Love — Keyshia Cole), the 2.0→5.1 badge, and every speaker's meter moving — and you can finally SEE the upmix filling your center and surrounds from stereo. Also fixed: 'EXE' now shows the real app name, and I reset the leftover test trims to a clean zero.
updated: plugin-mode metering + now-playing, verified on screen with your music

items.text: Root cause: meter loop died when app wasn't capturing (always, in plugin mode)
